headline: TEX @ STL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TEX 4.34 at STL 3.58, with a projected total of 7.92. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TEX: TEX moved -0.15 runs while STL moved -0.75, changing the projected margin by +0.60 runs. The projected total fell -0.91, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -13.9%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Michael McGreevy has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Josh Jung, JJ Wetherholt, Alec Burleson, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Nolan Gorman, Justin Foscue because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
